definition_quote.value: The practice of the profession of podiatry is defined as diagnosing, treating, operating and prescribing for any disease, injury, deformity or other condition of the foot, and may include performing physical evaluations in conjunction with the provision of podiatric treatment.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of the profession of podiatry is defined as diagnosing, treating, operating and prescribing for any disease, injury, deformity or other condition of the foot, and may include performing physical evaluations in conjunction with the provision of podiatric treatment.

value: treatment under general anesthesia administered by authorized persons
methods_authorized.quote: diagnosing, treating, operating and prescribing for any disease, injury, deformity or other condition of the foot, and may include performing physical evaluations in conjunction with the provision of podiatric treatment

drug_authority.value: May prescribe and administer narcotics (after certification by department); may administer local anesthetics; treatment under general anesthesia administered by authorized persons
drug_authority.quote: The practice of podiatry shall include administering only local anesthetics for therapeutic purposes as well as for anesthesia and treatment under general anesthesia administered by authorized persons.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the ankle and soft tissue of the leg below the tibial tuberosity if the podiatrist has obtained an issuance of a privilege to perform podiatric standard ankle surgery or advanced ankle surgery

anesthesia_authority.quote: The practice of podiatry shall include administering only local anesthetics for therapeutic purposes as well as for anesthesia and treatment under general anesthesia administered by authorized persons.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: The practice of podiatry may also include diagnosing, treating, operating and prescribing for any disease, injury, deformity or other condition of the ankle and soft tissue of the leg below the tibial tuberosity if the podiatrist has obtained an issuance of a privilege to perform podiatric standard ankle surgery or advanced ankle surgery

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: have graduated on or after June first, two thousand six from a three-year residency program in podiatric medicine and surgery that was accredited by an accrediting agency acceptable to the department

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: The holder of a limited permit issued pursuant to this section shall perform podiatric ankle surgery only in a hospital or health facility licensed pursuant to article twenty-eight of the public health law and appropriately authorized to provide such surgery.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: diagnosing, treating, operating and prescribing for any disease, injury, deformity, other condition of, or local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the foot

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the foot and the diagnosing, treating, and prescribing for any disease, injury, deformity, other condition of, or local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the ankle

value: national certifying board having certification standards acceptable to the department (reconstructive rearfoot and ankle surgery)
board_certification_body.quote: be certified in reconstructive rearfoot and ankle surgery by a national certifying board having certification standards acceptable to the department

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: An unlicensed person may provide supportive services to a podiatrist incidental to and concurrent with such podiatrist personally performing a service or procedure.

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: An unlicensed person providing supportive services to a podiatrist may operate radiographic equipment under direct supervision for the sole purpose of foot radiography

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: operate radiographic equipment under direct supervision for the sole purpose of foot radiography provided that such person completes a course of study acceptable to the department in consultation with the department of health.

total_ankle_replacement_authorized.quote: The practice of podiatry by any licensee shall not include partial or total ankle replacements nor the treatment of pilon fractures.

tibial_pilon_fracture_excluded.quote: The practice of podiatry by any licensee shall not include partial or total ankle replacements nor the treatment of pilon fractures.

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: Wound care shall not, however, extend beyond the level ending at the distal tibial tuberosity.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Any manufacturer or merchant may sell, advertise, fit, or adjust proprietary foot remedies, arch supports, corrective foot appliances or shoes.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The license and registration of a licensee who may be temporarily incapacitated for the active practice of a profession licensed pursuant to title eight of this chapter...whose alleged incapacity is the result of a problem of drug or alcohol abuse which has not resulted in harm to a patient or client, may be voluntarily surrendered to the department
